fields.title: Data Analyst – AI Consulting
fields.skills_required: SQL, Excel, Python, Power BI, Tableau, data cleaning, data visualization, analytical thinking, communication, problem solving
fields.description:
TailorFlow AI is a Cambridge‑based enterprise AI services firm that builds custom‑made solutions for complex business challenges. Though its headquarters sit in the UK, the company has a truly global footprint, serving clients across the United Kingdom, South Africa, the Americas and Australia. The business model is heavily asynchronous, allowing team members to work across time zones while still maintaining a few hours of overlap with the client’s geography. This flexibility is a core part of TailorFlow’s culture and makes it an attractive place for professionals who value autonomy and a results‑driven environment.

In recent months, TailorFlow has expanded its delivery centre to India, hiring remote analysts, engineers and consultants who can collaborate with the core Cambridge team. The Indian cohort works on the same high‑impact projects, gaining exposure to international standards, cutting‑edge AI research and real‑world deployments. The company prides itself on hiring people who take ownership, approach ambiguity constructively and stay positive while navigating complex problem spaces.

The role of Data Analyst – AI Consulting sits at the intersection of data engineering, business analysis and AI solution design. You will partner with consulting and engineering teams to understand client data, assess its suitability for AI use cases and translate insights into actionable recommendations. Your day‑to‑day activities will involve cleaning and exploring both structured and unstructured datasets, defining key performance metrics, supporting model validation, and creating visualisations that are easy for non‑technical stakeholders to digest. You will also act as a bridge between the client’s business objectives and the technical implementation, ensuring that data‑driven decisions are grounded in solid analysis.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Explore, clean and analyse structured and unstructured client data sets.
2. Assess data quality, completeness and suitability for AI and machine‑learning use cases.
3. Define relevant metrics and prepare concise analytical summaries for project teams.
4. Support model evaluation, testing and output validation activities.
5. Create visualisations and dashboards that communicate findings to non‑technical stakeholders.
6. Collaborate with consultants and engineers to translate analytical insights into solution decisions.
7. Identify data‑quality issues, document their impact and propose remediation strategies.
8. Maintain clear documentation of data pipelines, assumptions and analytical methods.
9. Stay updated on emerging AI trends and suggest innovative approaches to client problems.
10. Contribute to knowledge‑sharing sessions within the team to uplift overall analytical capability.

Tech Stack: SQL, Microsoft Excel, Python (pandas, numpy), Power BI, Tableau, basic knowledge of machine‑learning concepts.

Growth Path: Starting as a Junior Data Analyst, you can progress to Senior Analyst, then to Data Scientist or AI Consultant, eventually moving into lead or managerial roles as the practice scales.

Why Join TailorFlow AI? You will work on real AI implementations for a diverse set of international clients, gain exposure to multiple industries, and receive mentorship from seasoned founders and technical specialists. The remote‑first model offers flexibility, meaningful ownership of deliverables, and rapid career progression in a small, high‑performing team.
fields.eligibility: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Statistics or related fields; any branch accepted. Minimum 60% aggregate (or CGPA 6.0/10). Fresh graduates from 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026 batches are eligible. Maximum one active backlog allowed at the time of joining. Strong analytical mindset and good communication skills are mandatory.

fields.description:
Mastercard is a global payments and technology company that connects consumers, merchants, financial institutions and governments worldwide. With a presence in over 210 countries and territories, Mastercard drives innovation in digital payments, data analytics and security solutions. The company is known for its strong culture of inclusion, continuous learning, and a commitment to building a more open and secure financial ecosystem. Employees benefit from exposure to cutting‑edge technologies, cross‑functional collaboration, and a vibrant community that encourages growth and impact.

The role of Software Engineer I at Mastercard Pune is designed for fresh graduates and early‑career professionals (0‑3 years of experience) who are eager to contribute to the full software development lifecycle. As a member of the engineering team, you will be involved in designing, coding, testing, deploying, and maintaining secure, scalable applications that power Mastercard’s payment platforms. You will work closely with product managers, senior engineers, and distributed teams across geographies, ensuring that solutions meet stringent security standards and performance expectations.

Key responsibilities include:
1. Develop, test, and debug application code following Mastercard’s engineering standards.
2. Write comprehensive documentation and maintain design artifacts.
3. Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of coding practices.
4. Perform unit, integration and regression testing to ensure high‑quality releases.
5. Support production environments through incident management and on‑call pager rotation.
6. Evaluate alternative technical solutions, conduct feasibility studies, and recommend optimal approaches.
7. Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to deliver features within agreed timelines and budgets.
8. Follow secure software development practices and adhere to Mastercard’s security policies.
9. Assist senior engineers in creating and updating project documentation templates.
10. Track and report project metrics to drive process efficiency.

The typical tech stack includes Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, SQL/NoSQL databases, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. Mastercard offers a clear growth path: early engineers can progress to Software Engineer II, Senior Engineer, and eventually to Lead or Architect roles, with opportunities to move into product management or specialized security domains. Joining Mastercard means working in a future‑focused environment where innovation, mentorship, and global impact are part of everyday work, making it an ideal launchpad for a thriving software engineering career.

fields.skills_required: Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, Data Structures, Algorithms, Git, Problem Solving, Communication, Teamwork
fields.description:
Weekday Works, the client behind this opening, is a fast‑growing software development firm that builds end‑to‑end digital solutions for startups and mid‑size enterprises. With a culture rooted in curiosity, collaboration and continuous learning, the company has delivered products ranging from web applications to AI‑enabled platforms. Their engineering teams work in agile squads, encouraging junior members to take ownership early and experiment with the latest tools. The firm’s emphasis on mentorship and real‑world impact makes it an attractive launchpad for fresh talent.

The Software Engineer Intern role is designed for enthusiastic undergraduates or recent graduates who want to transition classroom knowledge into production‑grade code. Over a minimum two‑month stint (extendable up to six months), the intern will sit alongside senior engineers, contribute to feature development, and gain exposure to the full software lifecycle—from requirement gathering to deployment and monitoring. The position is fully remote, allowing candidates from across India to collaborate via video calls, shared repositories, and cloud‑based development environments.

Key responsibilities include:
1. Assist in designing, coding, and testing new software features under guidance.
2. Debug and resolve defects reported by QA or end‑users.
3. Write clean, maintainable code following the team’s coding standards.
4. Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback.
5. Contribute to performance optimisation and scalability discussions.
6. Document technical implementations and update project wikis.
7. Collaborate with product managers to understand user stories and acceptance criteria.
8. Explore and prototype emerging technologies such as cloud services or AI/ML APIs.
9. Support continuous integration pipelines and automated testing.
10. Share learnings in weekly demo sessions and team retrospectives.

The tech stack primarily revolves around Python and JavaScript (Node.js/React), with exposure to cloud platforms like AWS or GCP, and version control via Git. Interns will also get a glimpse of containerisation (Docker) and CI/CD tools (Jenkins/GitHub Actions). Growth prospects are clear: high‑performing interns may receive a full‑time offer, transition into junior engineer roles, and later advance to senior or lead positions as they deepen expertise.

Why join? Apart from a competitive stipend, the internship offers hands‑on experience on live projects, mentorship from seasoned engineers, and a chance to build a portfolio that stands out to future employers. The remote setup provides flexibility, while the collaborative culture ensures you never feel isolated. This is an ideal stepping stone for anyone aiming to launch a career in software engineering.

fields.description:
Swiggy, founded in 2014, has rapidly become India’s leading online food ordering and delivery platform, operating in more than 500 cities and serving millions of customers daily. Backed by strong venture capital and a culture of relentless innovation, Swiggy has expanded its ecosystem to include Swiggy Stores, Instamart, and a suite of logistics solutions that power not only food delivery but also grocery and quick commerce. The company’s engineering team is at the heart of this growth, building scalable, high‑performance systems that handle massive real‑time data streams, complex routing algorithms, and seamless user experiences across web and mobile.

The Software Development Engineer (SDE) role at Swiggy is designed for fresh graduates and early‑career professionals who are passionate about building large‑scale, customer‑centric products. As an SDE, you will work closely with product managers, designers, and senior engineers to translate business requirements into robust code, ship features end‑to‑end, and continuously improve system reliability. Whether you join as an SDE‑1, SDE‑2, or SDE‑3, you will be expected to take ownership of components, mentor peers, and contribute to architectural discussions.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Design, develop, and maintain micro‑services that power core Swiggy functionalities such as order placement, tracking, and payment processing.
2. Write clean, testable, and efficient code in languages like Java, Python, or Go.
3. Participate in code reviews, ensuring adherence to best practices and coding standards.
4. Optimize database queries and work with NoSQL stores (e.g., Cassandra, Redis) for high‑throughput data access.
5. Collaborate with data engineering teams to build real‑time analytics pipelines.
6. Implement CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar tools to enable rapid deployments.
7. Diagnose and resolve production incidents, ensuring minimal downtime and high availability.
8. Contribute to system design documents and technical specifications.
9. Stay updated with emerging technologies and propose improvements to existing systems.
10. Mentor junior developers and share knowledge through brown‑bag sessions.

Tech Stack: Java, Python, Go, Spring Boot, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS/GCP, Kafka, Cassandra, Redis, MySQL, React/Angular for front‑end, Git, Jenkins.

Growth Path: Swiggy offers a clear career ladder – from SDE‑1 to SDE‑3, then to Senior Engineer, Lead Engineer, and eventually Engineering Manager. Regular performance cycles, internal mobility, and exposure to cross‑functional projects accelerate professional development.

Why Join Swiggy? You will be part of a fast‑moving, data‑driven environment that impacts millions of users daily. The company invests heavily in learning, provides mentorship from industry veterans, and encourages a culture of ownership and experimentation. If you thrive on solving complex problems at scale and want to shape the future of food and logistics in India, Swiggy is the ideal platform.

fields.description:

The firm blends deep industry expertise with cutting‑edge digital, cloud and security capabilities, helping clients across 40+ industries transform their businesses. Known for its culture of continuous learning, Accenture invests heavily in upskilling its people through programs like myNav, Accenture Academy and the Innovation Architecture, ensuring that employees stay ahead of technology curves. The company’s commitment to diversity, inclusion and sustainability makes it a preferred employer for young talent seeking a purpose‑driven career.

The role of a BI Engineering Associate sits within Accenture’s Reinvention Deployment Engineering (RDE) practice, which accelerates delivery of engineering and R&D solutions by marrying human expertise with AI‑driven agents. As a member of the RDE‑Analytics team, you will be responsible for designing, building, optimizing and governing dashboards, executive scorecards, self‑service reports and data‑storytelling solutions for Accenture’s Operations clients. The position is ideal for fresh graduates or early‑career professionals with a passion for data visualization and a willingness to learn modern analytics platforms.

Key responsibilities include:
1. Develop interactive Power BI reports and dashboards, incorporating DAX measures and Power Query transformations.
2. Create Tableau visualisations where required, supporting executive‑level storytelling.
3. Write and optimise SQL queries for data extraction, validation and transformation.
4. Participate in dimensional modelling and ETL design, ensuring data quality and consistency.

Why join Accenture? You gain exposure to world‑class clients, cutting‑edge technologies, and a collaborative environment that encourages innovation. fields.title: Associate Demand Management
fields.skills_required: SQL, Excel, Data Analysis, Business Analytics, Financial Modeling, Communication, Stakeholder Management
fields.description:
Myntra, founded in 2007, started as a customization company and has grown into India’s leading fashion and lifestyle e‑commerce platform. With a blend of technology, design, and data‑driven decision making, the company now serves millions of customers across the country, offering a wide range of apparel, accessories and home décor. Its headquarters in Bangalore houses a vibrant mix of engineers, designers, marketers and analysts who work together to create a seamless shopping experience. The brand is known for its aggressive discount events, fast fashion turnover, and a culture that encourages experimentation and rapid execution.

The organization prides itself on meritocracy, equal opportunity, and a collaborative spirit. Employees are empowered with the right tools and autonomy to innovate, and the company invests heavily in learning and development programs. Over the years, Myntra has received accolades for its technology stack, customer obsession, and employee satisfaction, making it a coveted destination for fresh talent looking to make an impact in the fashion tech space.

**Role Summary**
The Associate Demand Management role sits at the intersection of analytics, finance and business operations. The incumbent will monitor key performance indicators, work closely with the analytics and finance teams, and help shape pricing and discount strategies for top brands. By analysing revenue trends, inventory health and marketing effectiveness, the associate will provide actionable insights that drive profitability and customer loyalty.

**Key Responsibilities**
1. Monitor and report on metrics such as revenue per unit, gross margin, conversion rate, AOV and customer acquisition cost.
2. Collaborate with the analytics team to evaluate the impact of marketing campaigns and suggest optimisation tactics.
3. Liaise with finance to ensure accurate P&L reporting for the assigned portfolio.
4. Reconcile discount allocations with brand partners and validate sale‑day funding.
5. Track competitor pricing and discounting on other portals to maintain parity and prevent churn.
6. Analyse inventory trends, stock cover and the effect of promotional initiatives on sales.
7. Influence cross‑functional stakeholders to meet project timelines and business goals.
8. Design and implement reporting processes for operational efficiency.
9. Conduct sales forecasting and trend analysis to support strategic planning.
10. Develop innovative analytical models that inform new pricing dimensions.

**Tech Stack & Tools**
SQL, Advanced Excel (pivot tables, macros), Tableau/PowerBI for visualisation, basic Python/R for data manipulation, and familiarity with ERP/CRM systems.

**Growth Path**
Successful associates can progress to Senior Analyst, Demand Management Lead, or move laterally into Product Analytics, Category Management or Finance roles, with clear mentorship and up‑skilling opportunities.

**Why Join Myntra?**
Myntra offers a fast‑paced environment where fresh ideas are welcomed, a competitive compensation package, exposure to large‑scale data sets, and the chance to influence the fashion choices of an entire nation. The company’s emphasis on learning, diversity and work‑life balance makes it an ideal launchpad for a career in data‑driven business strategy.

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is one of the world’s largest IT services and consulting firms, renowned for its robust delivery model, cutting‑edge technology solutions, and a culture that nurtures talent across the globe. Through the TCS iON National Qualifier Test (NQT), millions of aspirants gain a validated credential that is recognized by over 4,000 corporates spanning 23 industries, ranging from IT and BFSI to FMCG and EdTech. The platform not only assesses core aptitude and domain skills but also provides detailed feedback, helping candidates understand their strengths and areas for improvement.

The role of a TCS iON NQT candidate is essentially that of a job‑seeker who leverages a standardized, industry‑validated assessment to unlock interview opportunities across a wide spectrum of roles – from software development and cloud engineering to sales, business analysis, and HR. By appearing for the test, candidates receive a scorecard that showcases performance across cognitive, technical, and work‑value sections, which can be directly shared with hiring managers of partner companies. This creates a streamlined recruitment pipeline where recruiters can quickly shortlist candidates based on objective data, reducing time‑to‑hire and enhancing match quality.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Prepare for and appear in the scheduled TCS iON NQT (aptitude, technical, and work‑value modules). 
2. Analyze the detailed scorecard to identify skill gaps and work on targeted improvement. 
3. Register on the TCS iON portal and upload the NQT score to the job board. 
4. Apply to multiple job openings across partner corporates using the same scorecard. 
5. Participate in subsequent company‑specific interview rounds as invited. 
6. Maintain a professional profile on the portal, highlighting projects, internships, and extracurricular achievements. 
7. Attend webinars and mock tests organized by TCS iON for continuous upskilling. 
8. Provide feedback to TCS iON on the assessment experience to help refine future tests. 
9. Keep track of application status and follow up with recruiters. 
10. Uphold ethical standards during the assessment and recruitment process.

Tech Stack & Knowledge Areas: While the NQT itself does not require a specific programming language, candidates targeting IT roles should be comfortable with fundamentals such as data structures, algorithms, OOP concepts, basic SQL, and cloud basics. Growth Path: Successful candidates can secure entry‑level positions such as Analyst, Associate, or Trainee across partner firms. With performance‑driven promotions, they can progress to Senior Analyst, Team Lead, and eventually managerial roles within 3‑5 years. The NQT score remains a valuable credential for future internal mobility and upskilling opportunities.

Why Join Through TCS iON NQT? The platform offers a single, credible assessment that is accepted by thousands of employers, eliminating the need to sit for multiple tests. Candidates gain visibility, receive structured feedback, and benefit from TCS’s brand reputation, which often translates into higher salary offers and accelerated career growth.

fields.description:
Mercor is a leading AI‑training partner that collaborates with top research labs and enterprises to build high‑quality datasets for next‑generation document understanding models. The company focuses on under‑represented scripts and languages, creating diverse, human‑verified training data that powers commercial and academic AI solutions. With a distributed workforce and a strong emphasis on quality over speed, Mercor empowers specialists to contribute to cutting‑edge research while enjoying flexible, remote work arrangements.

The role of PDF Annotation & Transcription Expert – Telugu is pivotal in expanding the corpus of Telugu documents for machine learning. You will source publicly available Telugu PDFs that contain complex layouts such as multi‑column newspapers, exam sheets, and handwritten forms. Your primary responsibility is to produce a detailed structural map of each page, identifying every meaningful region—titles, headings, paragraphs, tables, figures, captions, formulas, and handwritten content. Each region must be bounded, typed, and assigned a reading‑order index, while also linking sub‑components to their parent figures or tables. Accuracy is paramount; a single diacritic error is considered a defect. After annotation, you will transcribe the text verbatim in Telugu script, flagging illegible areas. Your work will be reviewed by a second expert to ensure consistency and correctness.

Key responsibilities include:
1. Locating and verifying publicly accessible Telugu PDFs across diverse domains.
2. Identifying and bounding every meaningful page region.
3. Assigning component types and reading‑order indices.
4. Linking related regions through parent identifiers.
5. Transcribing text accurately in Telugu script, including handwritten content.
6. Capturing page metadata such as language, dimensions, and special flags.
7. Reviewing peer annotations and providing constructive feedback.
8. Maintaining consistency with the established taxonomy across hundreds of pages.
9. Reporting any layout or content anomalies.
10. Contributing to the expansion of the dataset with diverse document templates.

The ideal candidate is a native Telugu speaker with a strong command of the script, experience in document annotation or localization, and meticulous attention to detail. Familiarity with OCR post‑editing, Unicode normalization, and regional‑language AI datasets is a plus.

Growth path: Successful annotators can progress to senior annotation leads, project managers, or data quality specialists within Mercor’s AI training ecosystem. The role offers exposure to advanced document AI research, opportunities to influence model training pipelines, and a chance to work with a global team of language experts.

Why join Mercor? You’ll be at the forefront of building AI that understands complex scripts, work from anywhere, and earn competitive hourly rates. The company values quality, offers flexible schedules, and provides a supportive environment for continuous learning and skill development.
fields.eligibility: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (or equivalent experience). Native Telugu speaker with full command of Telugu script and diacritics. Proven experience in transcription, annotation, or related document work is preferred. No backlog policy; candidates must demonstrate consistent accuracy and reliability.

fields.description:
Tata Group, one of India’s most respected conglomerates, has a legacy of over 150 years of innovation, social responsibility, and global leadership across sectors such as automotive, steel, IT services, telecommunications, and hospitality. The group’s commitment to nurturing young talent is evident through initiatives like the Tata Imagination Challenge, which provides a platform for students to showcase breakthrough ideas that can drive societal change. The 2026 edition of the challenge expands its reach to all undergraduate and postgraduate students across the country, inviting fresh perspectives from engineering, design, medicine, humanities, business, and beyond. Participants get a rare opportunity to interact directly with senior Tata leaders, receive mentorship from early‑career professionals, and potentially secure cash prizes, immersive experiences, and career pathways within the Tata ecosystem.

The role of a participant in the Tata Imagination Challenge is both a learning journey and a high‑stakes competition. Over a span of three months, candidates progress through a series of structured rounds that test knowledge, logical agility, creativity, and presentation finesse. The first round, the Tata Quiz, evaluates general knowledge, quantitative aptitude, and critical thinking through 20 multiple‑choice questions in 20 minutes. Successful candidates move to the Game Plan stage, a gamified assessment of logic, reasoning, and reflexes, supported by practice modules. The #ImagineThat Idea Pitch requires contestants to record a concise two‑minute video, answer three written questions, and attend masterclasses that sharpen pitching skills. The top 100 are then invited to the Idea Defence Round, a live virtual presentation before a leadership panel, followed by a mentorship‑driven Idea Buddy Phase for finalists. The competition culminates in a Finale where up to 30 finalists present to senior Tata executives, with the top 10 receiving cash prizes of up to ₹2 lakh, an all‑expenses‑paid immersion at a Tata location, and direct exposure to recruitment opportunities.

Key responsibilities for participants include: 
1. Preparing thoroughly for the Tata Quiz by revising quantitative and logical concepts. 
2. Engaging with the Game Plan platform, completing practice modules, and ensuring a stable internet connection. 
3. Conducting research to identify a socially relevant problem and crafting an innovative solution. 
4. Developing a clear, compelling two‑minute video pitch and answering written prompts with precision. 
5. Actively participating in virtual masterclasses and doubt‑clearing sessions. 
6. Refining the idea based on feedback from mentors during the Idea Buddy Phase. 
7. Delivering a confident live presentation during the Idea Defence and Finale rounds. 
8. Promoting the idea on the public voting platform for the Popular Choice Awards. 
9. Networking with Tata leaders, TAS managers, and fellow innovators. 
10. Demonstrating professionalism, teamwork, and adaptability throughout the competition. 

While there is no specific tech stack required, participants often leverage tools such as PowerPoint, video editing apps, data visualization software, and basic prototyping platforms to articulate their concepts. The growth path is unique: winners gain direct visibility to Tata recruiters, mentorship from senior executives, and a credential that enhances their resume across industries. Joining this challenge offers unparalleled exposure, a chance to turn an idea into a real‑world impact, and a gateway to a career with one of India’s most prestigious conglomerates.
fields.eligibility: All full‑time undergraduate and postgraduate students enrolled in any discipline are eligible. There is no restriction on branch, percentage, or year of study. Candidates must be Indian residents, have a valid student ID, and should not have any pending academic backlogs at the time of application. The competition is open to the 2025, 2026, and 2027 batch years, but any currently enrolled student can apply.

Headquartered in the United States, IBM operates in over 170 countries and is a leader in hybrid cloud, artificial intelligence, quantum computing, and blockchain. In India, IBM has a strong presence across major metros, delivering cutting‑edge solutions to Fortune 500 clients and driving digital transformation across industries such as banking, healthcare, retail, and manufacturing. The role of Data Engineer – Data Platforms sits within IBM Consulting’s FutureNow Centers, where teams blend deep technical expertise with industry knowledge to help clients modernize their data landscapes. As a Data Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and platforms that enable advanced analytics, AI, and real‑time insights. You will work closely with data scientists, solution architects, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust, production‑grade data solutions.

Key responsibilities include:
- Designing end‑to‑end data ingestion pipelines on big‑data frameworks (e.g., Spark, Hadoop, Flink).

- Writing, testing, and debugging high‑performance code in Java/Scala/Python.

- Leveraging statistical and machine‑learning libraries (e.g., MLlib, Scikit‑learn) to enrich data platforms.
- Implementing data quality, governance, and security controls in compliance with enterprise standards.
- Optimizing data storage solutions on cloud platforms (IBM Cloud, AWS, Azure) using data‑warehousing technologies like Snowflake or IBM Db2.
- Collaborating with cross‑functional teams to define data models, schemas, and performance benchmarks.
- Conducting code reviews, mentoring junior engineers, and contributing to best‑practice documentation.

The tech stack typically involves Hadoop ecosystem tools, Apache Spark, Kafka, REST APIs, Python/Scala, SQL, cloud services (IBM Cloud, AWS), and NLP/ML libraries. IBM offers a clear growth path: junior engineers can progress to senior data engineer, lead architect, or solution manager roles, with opportunities to specialize in AI, cloud, or industry‑specific solutions. Joining IBM means access to world‑class training, mentorship from industry veterans, and the chance to work on projects that shape the future of enterprise data. The company’s commitment to diversity, flexible hybrid work arrangements, and a supportive learning environment make it an ideal place for ambitious engineers to thrive.

Over the past few years, BruntWork has expanded its portfolio to include logistics, e‑commerce, and supply‑chain operations, creating a steady demand for order‑processing and data‑entry experts.

The Order Processing & Data Entry Specialist role is designed for meticulous individuals who can bridge the gap between physical warehouse activities and digital records. As a remote independent contractor, you will be the first line of defense in ensuring that every purchase order, shipment, and inventory movement is accurately captured in the client’s ERP system (Microsoft Dynamics Business Central). 1. Verify purchase order details – shipping address, item quantities, product specifications – for completeness and correctness before entry.
2. Perform high‑volume data entry into Business Central, maintaining a 99.5% accuracy rate.

fields.description:
Apple Inc., a global leader in consumer electronics, software, and services, has built its reputation on innovation, design excellence, and a relentless focus on user experience. With a presence in more than 100 countries, Apple’s ecosystem spans hardware like iPhone, iPad, Mac, and services such as iCloud, Apple Music, and the App Store. The company’s culture emphasizes creativity, collaboration, and a commitment to making technology accessible to everyone, regardless of ability. In India, Apple’s Hyderabad campus serves as a hub for engineering talent, driving forward web and mobile experiences that reach millions of users.

The role of Web Accessibility Engineer is a specialized front‑end engineering position that blends deep technical knowledge with a passion for inclusive design. As part of Apple’s accessibility team, you will evaluate web applications against WCAG 2.x and WAI‑ARIA standards, identify barriers for users of assistive technologies, and deliver clean, maintainable code fixes. You will work closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to embed accessibility considerations early in the development lifecycle, ensuring that every feature launched by Apple is usable by people with diverse abilities.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Conduct manual and automated accessibility audits of web applications using tools and screen‑readers (VoiceOver, JAWS, NVDA). 
2. Document findings with clear, reproducible steps and prioritize remediation based on impact. 
3. Write and review semantic HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to meet WCAG 2.x success criteria. 
4. Implement ARIA roles, states, and properties where native HTML cannot provide required semantics. 
5. Collaborate with UI/UX designers to create accessible visual designs, focusing on color contrast, focus indicators, and keyboard navigation. 
6. Provide guidance and training to development teams on accessibility best practices and testing methodologies. 
7. Participate in cross‑functional design reviews to advocate for inclusive user experiences. 
8. Contribute to internal accessibility guidelines, tooling, and knowledge‑base articles. 
9. Stay updated with evolving standards, browser support, and emerging assistive technologies. 
10. Assist in preparing accessibility compliance reports for internal and external stakeholders.

Tech Stack: HTML5, CSS3 (Flexbox, Grid), modern JavaScript (ES6+), React or similar front‑end frameworks, accessibility testing tools (axe, Lighthouse), screen‑reader software (VoiceOver, JAWS, NVDA), CI/CD pipelines for automated accessibility checks.

Growth Path: Starting as an entry‑level engineer, you can progress to Senior Accessibility Engineer, Accessibility Lead, or move into broader front‑end or product management roles. Apple encourages continuous learning, offering internal courses, conferences, and mentorship programs.

Why Join Apple? Apple’s commitment to accessibility is world‑renowned; you will be part of a mission‑driven team that shapes products used by billions. The company offers competitive compensation, generous benefits, and a collaborative environment where innovative ideas are celebrated. Working in Hyderabad gives you exposure to a vibrant tech community while contributing to a global brand.
